How to read: These are single-throw, best-case catch chances. Verify each ball’s condition before throwing; the tool does not inspect your battle. Balls without a species-specific bonus appear under “No special bonus”.

Accuracy: When 1 HP is selected, maximum HP is estimated using representative level-50 stats, so actual odds may differ slightly. Catch chances use the existing PokeMMO-style approximation. Alpha calculations use a fixed base catch-rate value of 10.

Sources: Species information from the supplied PokeMMO Pokédex export (October 2026). Ball rules: PokeMMO Wiki – Poké Ball, plus user-confirmed in-game modifiers; developer clarification of the PokeMMO formula.

BALL REFERENCE

Poké Ball Multiplier Guide

All 18 supported balls, their catch multipliers and activation conditions.

How multipliers work

A ×4 catch multiplier affects the capture formula; it does not mean a 40% catch chance or guarantee four times the final probability. Species catch rate, HP and status also matter.

Detailed bonus tables

Heavy Ball — species weight thresholds

Uses species weight, not temporary in-battle changes. Below 100 kg there is no special bonus.

Species weightCatch modifier
Below 100 kg×1
100 to under 200 kg×2
200 to under 300 kg×3
300 kg or more×4
Nest Ball — wild Pokémon level thresholds

The bonus is ×4 at levels 1–16, decreases by 0.2 per level until level 30, and is ×1 from level 31. The calculator shows reference cases for levels 1–16 and 20.

Why are some Poké Balls missing?

These six balls are intentionally outside the calculator’s scope.

  • Master Ball: Guaranteed capture; no probability comparison is needed.
  • Safari Ball: Safari encounters use different capture mechanics.
  • Luxury Ball: For the eligible friendship-evolution families, Friend Ball has the stronger bonus.
  • Premier Ball: Same ×1.5 multiplier as Great Ball.
  • Heal Ball: Excluded to keep the main comparison focused (×1.25).
  • Cherish Ball: Same ×2 multiplier as Ultra Ball.

Source: PokeMMO Poké Ball Wiki, supplemented by in-game confirmations.
